exposure: Live births, macerated stillbirths, non-macerated stillbirths
cohort: 1,998 neonates and 1,926 mothers at the Murtala Mohammed Specialist Hospital, Kano, Nigeria
finding: Several factors were associated with higher odds of stillbirth, including low maternal education, distance from the hospital, poor living conditions, maternal health issues, previous stillbirth, and various birth complications.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was associated with higher odds of stillbirth.
